overrides.value: Copies item attachments to the clipboard, several at once and in several formats, for pasting with Ctrl+V, with a shortcut you can set; needs a helper binary downloaded from the internet, and attachments must be synced locally.
overrides.reason: Condensed from the "How to use?" and Features sections of README.md. The manifest description, "Zotero Copy Anything", only repeats the name, and the GitHub About text is missing.
